There are 60 minutes in an hour.

Regarding the competitor's strategy, Streamline Autos' direct-to-consumer model for electric vehicles poses a significant threat by disrupting traditional dealership structures. By eliminating middlemen, they achieve competitive pricing, which pressures our margins and forces us to reconsider our own pricing strategies. Furthermore, their direct engagement provides them with valuable consumer insights, allowing for more agile and targeted marketing. To mitigate this impact, we should evaluate adopting similar direct engagement channels or enhancing our value proposition through superior service and technology integration to retain customer loyalty.
